capabilities: Push file changes to a self-hosted server after a 2s debounce
Pull remote changes on startup and on a polling interval
Receive real-time desktop updates via Server-Sent Events
Transfer only changed files via delta sync
Save stale writes as timestamped .conflict copies instead of overwriting
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Real-time push (SSE) is desktop-only; mobile relies on polling and sync-on-focus. Setup requires deploying a separate companion server.
intentEvidence: a lightweight self-hosted alternative to Obsidian Sync / obsidian-livesync
motivation: To offer a lightweight, self-hosted sync option with no vendor lock-in and no vault size limits beyond the user's own storage.
problem: Obsidian Sync is a paid hosted service, and existing sync options can have vault size limits or vendor lock-in.

relations.evidence: a lightweight self-hosted alternative to Obsidian Sync / obsidian-livesync
a lightweight self-hosted alternative to Obsidian Sync / obsidian-livesync

summary: Vault sync client that pairs with a self-hosted companion server to push, pull, and merge changes across devices.
